stories.title: Comment expliquer la large victoire de Raphaël Glucksmann à la primaire de la gauche ?

en.title: How to explain Raphaël Glucksmann's large victory in the left-wing primary?
en.summary: Raphaël Glucksmann won the left-wing primary with two-thirds of votes, significantly ahead of Socialist Party leader Olivier Faure, his main rival in the contest.

stories.title: Présidentielle 2027 : Raphaël Glucksmann, vainqueur de la primaire à gauche, au défi de mettre la famille sociale-démocrate en ordre de bataille

en.title: 2027 Presidential election: Raphaël Glucksmann, winner of the left-wing primary, facing the challenge of mobilizing the social-democrat family
en.summary: Glucksmann, co-president of Place publique, won the primary on the first round and called for a break with centrist policies and an end to left-wing dominance by Jean-Luc Mélenchon, while naming far-right extremism as the main threat.

stories.title: Primaire PS : pourquoi la victoire de Raphaël Glucksmann est une bonne nouvelle pour Jean-Luc Mélenchon

en.title: Socialist primary: why Raphaël Glucksmann's victory is good news for Jean-Luc Mélenchon
en.summary: Glucksmann's primary victory could lead him to compete with centrist and center-right forces, potentially creating more political space on the left for Mélenchon and his movement.

stories.title: Raphaël Glucksmann gagne la primaire de la gauche : "C'est la victoire de ceux qui croient qu'il faut une gauche démocratique dans notre pays", déclare le candidat à l'élection présidentielle

en.title: Raphaël Glucksmann wins the left-wing primary: "It is the victory of those who believe in a democratic left in our country", declares the presidential candidate
en.summary: Glucksmann, the Place publique candidate, won the Socialist Party-organized primary on October 11 with over 66 percent of votes on the first round, securing his official candidacy for the 2027 presidential election.

stories.title: Présidentielle 2027 : Raphaël Glucksmann élu dès le premier tour de la primaire à gauche

en.title: 2027 Presidential Election: Raphaël Glucksmann elected in the first round of the left-wing primary
en.summary: MEP Raphaël Glucksmann won the French left-wing primary in the first round and is now the official Socialist Party candidate for the 2027 presidential election.

stories.title: Raphaël Glucksmann largement élu candidat de la gauche sociale-démocrate pour la présidentielle

en.title: Raphaël Glucksmann overwhelmingly elected candidate of the social-democratic left for the presidential election
en.summary: The 46-year-old MEP Glucksmann won the social-democratic left primary in the first round, pledging to unite the democratic left and defeat the far-right despite divisions over alliances with France Unbowed.

stories.title: Primaire à gauche : après sa victoire, Hollande félicite Glucksmann, qui lui tend la main en vue de la présidentielle

en.title: Left primary: after his victory, Hollande congratulates Glucksmann, who reaches out to him ahead of the presidential election
en.summary: Glucksmann, the winner of the left primary, expressed openness to welcoming Hollande into his campaign movement for the upcoming presidential race.

stories.title: Primaire sociale-démocrate : Raphaël Glucksmann élu dès le premier tour avec 66 % des votes

en.title: Social-democratic primary: Raphaël Glucksmann elected in the first round with 66% of votes
en.summary: Place Publique leader Raphaël Glucksmann won the social-democratic left primary in the first round, decisively defeating Socialist Party leader Olivier Faure.

stories.title: Raphaël Glucksmann désigné dès le premier tour comme le candidat de la gauche sociale-démocrate

en.title: Raphaël Glucksmann designated in the first round as the social-democratic left's candidate
en.summary: The Place publique leader decisively outpaced Socialist Party chief Olivier Faure and extended outreach to other leftist forces excluding LFI.

stories.title: Vainqueur de la primaire, Raphaël Glucksmann promet «une campagne punk» pour la présidentielle

en.title: Primary winner Raphaël Glucksmann promises "punk campaign" for presidential election
en.summary: Place publique candidate Raphaël Glucksmann won the socialist primary on October 11 and is preparing for a presidential campaign, having discussed his trajectory and strategic changes before the vote.

stories.title: Résultats de la primaire socialiste : Raphaël Glucksmann élu dès le premier tour et propulsé vers la présidentielle

en.title: Socialist primary results: Raphaël Glucksmann elected in first round and propelled toward presidential election
en.summary: MEP Raphaël Glucksmann secured 66 percent of votes among 120,000 social-democrat voters on Sunday, substantially outperforming PS first secretary Olivier Faure who received only 14 percent.

stories.title: Présidentielle 2027 : vainqueur de la primaire dès le premier tour, Raphaël Glucksmann devient le candidat de la gauche non mélenchoniste

en.title: 2027 presidential election: primary winner Raphaël Glucksmann becomes candidate of non-Mélenchon left
en.summary: MEP Raphaël Glucksmann decisively won the primary with 66.17 percent of votes and must now unite defeated rivals including Olivier Faure and Ségolène Royal while facing competition from former president François Hollande.

en.title: Kinéis proposes its constellation to the European Commission to participate in the GovSatcom program
en.summary: Kinéis is bidding to join the European GovSatcom program to provide commercial services to all 27 EU member states using its 25-satellite constellation, operational since summer 2025.

en.title: The difficult return of Sophie Adenot
en.summary: Sophie Adenot returned to her home in Germany on October 10, two days after completing an extended orbital mission.

stories.title: Primaire sociale-démocrate : le plébiscite pour Raphaël Glucksmann

en.title: Social Democratic Primary: A landslide for Raphaël Glucksmann
en.summary: MEP Raphaël Glucksmann won the social democratic left primary decisively in the first round with over 66% of votes, emerging strengthened from the contested election.

stories.title: Présidentielle : Raphaël Glucksmann remporte largement la primaire sociale-démocrate dès le premier tour

en.title: Presidential Election: Raphaël Glucksmann wins social democratic primary decisively in first round
en.summary: MEP Raphaël Glucksmann secured 66% of votes in the first round of the social democratic left primary and will represent this faction in the 2027 presidential election.

stories.title: « Deminator » : l’incroyable saison de la reine du cyclisme, Demi Vollering

en.title: "Deminator": The incredible season of cycling queen Demi Vollering
en.summary: Dutch cyclist Demi Vollering won world and European championships while completing a brilliant season with FDJ United-Suez.
